steps.content: You return to the submarine. Everything feels so familiar—the scarred hull, the pressure gauge, and Ragnar, still unconscious beside you.
The submarine's power system is completely dead, but Pylgia remains outside the porthole, guiding countless white plankton to carry you upward.
As you draw closer to the surface, the long-dead radio mysteriously crackles back to life.
This is... hiss... please respond... repeat... this is... hiss... Please answer...
Pyl... Rag... Dale... do you copy...
Rescue is coming your... we...
Whether owing to the distance or other interference, the voice on the radio emerges urgent yet fragmented, laden with static. Nonetheless, you discern some crucial information.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia, did you hear that? It's the expedition! They're looking for you!

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Mm... I heard it.
Suddenly, you notice that the submarine's ascent begins to slow.

The water churns violently, as though attempting to prevent something from passing. Your fears and anguish have already been soothed, so you know that the obstruction does not stem from this battered submarine.
That leaves only one possibility.
Unknown to you, Pylgia has been undergoing a disturbing transmutation.
Barnacles cover her entire body in a dense mass, and new appendages visibly thrust out from beneath her skin, stretching into the deeper darkness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia, your body...
[Sound effect: sharp alarm]
Before you can finish speaking, a sharp noise pierces the air. You turn around and find the submarine has passed by a pre-installed alarm.
Monster... hiss... detected... alert... triggered... hiss... your position... watch out...
The once encouraging radio transmission now sounds painfully jarring. The "monster" they speak of is none but Pylgia herself, mutated beyond recognition.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not a monster—it's Pylgia!
You shout into the radio, but it proves all futile. Your signal can't possibly reach the people on the surface.
Watch for... hiss... mines... kill... we're coming... save... hiss... hang... there...
Anxiously, you rush to the porthole, only to find Pylgia's condition has grown even worse.
More appendages tear through her skin, revealing not blood but pale, rotting flesh beneath. Countless appendages writhe frantically toward the Abyss, yet their roots remain anchored in Pylgia's body.
With each inch of ascent, the appendages create more resistance. They're now stretched taut like steel cables, threatening to tear Pylgia's body apart.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Looks like... this is as far... as I can take you...
You know this scene all too well—the Abyss has found Pylgia's fears and bound her here, just as it once did to you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't be afraid. They just don't know it's you... I'll explain to them right now!
You try again and again to reach your companions' frequency on the surface, but the radio emits nothing but static.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I... can't go back anymore.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The expedition will accept you. They will!

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I know... I... trust them...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: But that... would be painful... and take too much unnecessary effort...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: They would set aside... missions more valuable than life itself... to care for me... to "cure" me.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: That's not... what I want.
Pylgia's body has been stretched to its absolute limit, unable to rise even an inch further.
She keeps her promise, escorting you until the very end. However, eventually, she ceases her struggle, descending into the Abyss like a kite bereft of its only thread.
[Big CG 1 Section 2]

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Go. Bring Ragnar and the collectors back to them.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Go back... to them.
Before you can utter a word, Pylgia expends her final vestige of strength to give the sub a tender push.
(CG2)

Watching as Pylgia drifts further and further away, you desperately wrestle with the helm in futile attempts to reach her. But the battle-worn submarine has long since stopped responding to your commands.
As the entrance to the Abyss slowly seals off, she fades into the darkness along with the countless appendages writhing around her.
